content:
Returns a list of profiles. The type of profiles returned depends on the sensor_type  path
parameter, which can be set to either agent  or scanners .
Requires the Scan Operator [24] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string
Enum: "agent"
"scanners"
The type of sensor. Use agent  for agent profiles or scanners  for
scanner profiles.
